listing_text:
🏷️ 28" Shimano Nexus 7 Rear Wheel Mach 1 Disc
📦 Item ID: #WRS05
💰 Price: 500 DKK

🚲 Compatibility: Heavy-duty 28" (700c / 622mm) city or e-bike frames with 135mm rear dropouts, Shimano Nexus 7-speed, and disc brakes

📝 Description:
Solid 28" rear city/e-bike wheel featuring a Shimano Nexus Inter-7 internal gear hub (SG-C3001-7D) with disc brake support. Built on a Mach 1 630 622x21C double-wall alloy rim. Includes a mounted 160 mm Shimano disc rotor and a SCO Premium E-Bike ready tire (47-622) with plenty of tread and reflective sidewalls. Ready to mount.

🔧 Technical Specifications:
• Compatibility: Heavy-duty 28" (700c / 622mm) city or e-bike frames with 135mm rear dropouts, Shimano Nexus 7-speed, and disc brakes
• Wheel Size: 28" / 700C (ETRTO 622x21C)
• Hub: Shimano Nexus Inter-7 (SG-C3001-7D) 7-speed
• Brake Compatibility: Disc Brake (160 mm rotor included)
• Rim: Mach 1 630 Alloy 6063-T6 double-wall
• Tire: SCO Premium E-Bike+ ECE-R75 (47-622 / 28x1.75)
• Color: Black rim, spokes, and hub

🚴 Ready to inspect and pick up in Copenhagen. Shipping available upon agreement.
